```{r}
# install.packages("rpart")
# install.packages("rpart.plot")

library('rpart')
library('rpart.plot')
library('readxl')
```


```{r}
df <- read_excel("C:\\Users\\diego\\Desktop\\base-de-datos-violencia-intrafamiliar-ano-2024_v3.xlsx")
df
```



```{r}
arbol <- rpart(VIC_OCUP ~
                  VIC_SEXO +
                 VIC_ALFAB +
                 VIC_TRABAJA,
               data = df,
               method = 'class')

rpart.plot(arbol, type=2, extra=0, under=TRUE, fallen.leaves=TRUE, box.palette = 'BuGn', main='VIC_OCUP', cex=.5)

```
```{r}
nuevo <- data.frame(
          VIC_SEXO=1,
         VIC_ALFAB=1,
         VIC_TRABAJA=1
)

predict(arbol, nuevo, type = "class")
```




```{r}
arbol <- rpart(AGR_EST_CIV ~
                 VIC_EDAD + 
                 AGR_EDAD + 
                 VIC_ESCOLARIDAD +
                 VIC_EST_CIV + 
                 VIC_ALFAB + 
                 NUM_HIJ_MUJ,
               
               data = df,
               method = 'class')

rpart.plot(arbol, type=2, extra=0, under=TRUE, fallen.leaves=TRUE, box.palette = 'BuGn', main='Titulo', cex=.5)
```
